currency.basis: The 2021-rebrand R app icon is declared current in the official guidelines retrieved live on 2026-10-03; the accepted icon's blue circle with white R is a different variant not present in the official package.

identity.basis: The R glyph is Revolut's own mark, supplied in Revolut's official logo package on developer.revolut.com and confirmed by the official guidelines PDF.

assessment.independenceRationale: Both sources are Revolut's own properties (official guidelines PDF and official logo package), one official provenance group; sufficent because currency of a current operating brand rests on official use.
uncertainties: developer.revolut.com HTML pages returned Cloudflare challenges to the session fetcher; the linked PDF and ZIP assets were fetched live and verified, and link discovery used Wayback CDX of live asset URLs.

variant.basis: Standalone app-icon variant: black R on a white square field. The letter forms the mark itself, so it is suitable; the wordmark variant with accompanying text was rejected.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Black R glyph contours identical to the official app-icon artwork in source/final comparison on both themes; internal transparency outside the circle preserved; white circular field is the source's own uniform field reshaped, no emblem pixel changed.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Whole-emblem fit confirmed: the R occupies the same central placement as in the 800x800 source; the circular background-only clip (r=400 centered) removes only white canvas corners, no glyph pixel (glyph bounds ~x209-629, y128-672, well inside the circle). Legible at 240px and 32px on both themes; the white field is invisible against a white page but the mark itself remains clear.
candidate.rationale: Documented rebrand update: the accepted icon is a #1326FD blue circle with a white R (variant not present in official materials); Revolut's official app icon is the black R on a white field, extracted losslessly from the official retail logo package.
candidate.role: catalog app-icon variant on its official white plain field, presented as a circle
transforms: Lossless member extraction of Revolut-01-retail-appicon-FINAL-01.svg from the official logo package zip (source-material replayed from the fetched resource).

Background-only circular mask: the source's uniform white square field replaced by a same-color circle (clipPath circle cx=400 cy=400 r=400) with transparency outside; black R paths copied unchanged, no scaling, translation or recoloring (plain-field circle rule).

SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen worktree svgo.config.mjs (sha256 f2a406e0...) trial produced 717 bytes vs 699-byte working version — optimization skipped (larger output); working version fully verified instead.
candidate.variant: official 2021-rebrand app icon: black R on white field, circular catalog presentation
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Accepted icon is a blue circle with white R; candidate is a white circle with the official black R — visibly different variant and colors.

proposals.reason: Accepted icon (sha256 83caa2f1...) is a #1326FD blue circle with a white R — an older/invented-color variant. Revolut's official 2021-rebrand app icon is a black R on a white field, confirmed current by the official Open Banking brand guidelines PDF retrieved live 2026-10-03, and the original app-icon SVG was losslessly extracted from the official retail logo package. Proposed as a candidate replacement.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Official original-vector app icon extracted losslessly from the official retail logo package; supports a documented rebrand/color-corrected update over the accepted non-official blue-circle variant.

sources.observation: Official Revolut rebrand guidelines PDF ('Rebrand | revolut | guidelines', 14 pages): the lowercase wordmark is the primary logo and 'the same R from the wordmark is used for the app icon'. Confirms the 2021-rebrand identity as current.

Official downloadable logo package linked from developer.revolut.com open-banking logo guidelines. Contains original Illustrator SVG exports including Revolut-01-retail-appicon-FINAL-01.svg (800x800, white rect + black R); selected losslessly via source-material from the fetched zip. The wordmark SVG was rejected for catalog use because of the accompanying name.
